```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Publication figures: every chunk figure is also written as a vector PDF (and a 300 dpi PNG)
# to Figures_2026b/CytoTRACE2/, named after its chunk, for the figure bundle.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = c("png", "cairo_pdf"), dpi = 300, fig.path = "../Figures_2026b/CytoTRACE2/")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, comment = "",
                      fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(patchwork)
library(ggsignif)
library(ggrepel)
library(plotly)
source("config_colors_2026b.R")

# Scores and gene correlations come from run_cytotrace2_2026b.R (no Seurat object is loaded here).
ct_dir <- "../Outputs/CytoTRACE2_2026b"
meta <- fread("../new_data_2026b/full_meta_full.csv.gz",
              select = c("cell", "Sample", "orig.ident", "Patient_nr", "origin", "Malignant", "majority_celltype",
                         "secondary_mutation", "primary_location", "healthy_location"))
ct <- qs2::qs_read(file.path(ct_dir, "cytotrace2_scores.qs2"), nthreads = 1)
d <- merge(meta, ct[, .(cell, CytoTRACE2_Score, CytoTRACE2_Potency)], by = "cell")
stopifnot("not every atlas cell is scored" = nrow(d) == 349696 && nrow(meta) == 349696, !anyNA(d$CytoTRACE2_Score))
d[, origin := factor(origin, levels = c("non-malignant", "primary", "metastasis"))]
stopifnot(!anyNA(d$origin))

sets <- c(malignant = "Malignant cells", healthy_melanocyte = "Non-malignant melanocytes", all_cells = "All cells")
set_n <- c(malignant = sum(d$Malignant == "Malignant"),
           healthy_melanocyte = sum(d$majority_celltype == "Melanocytes" & d$origin == "non-malignant"),
           all_cells = nrow(d))
cors <- setNames(lapply(names(sets), function(s) fread(file.path(ct_dir, sprintf("gene_cor_%s.csv", s)))), names(sets))
n_sig <- 50
# Signatures in the gene,correlation,direction format of cytotrace2_signature_xenium.csv (used by report 14).
sig <- lapply(names(sets), function(s) {
  g <- cors[[s]]
  out <- rbind(g[order(-correlation)][1:n_sig][, direction := "Top"],
               g[order(correlation)][1:n_sig][, direction := "Bottom"])[, .(gene, correlation, direction)]
  fwrite(out, file.path(ct_dir, sprintf("stemness_signature_%s_top%d.csv", s, n_sig)))
  out
}) |> setNames(names(sets))

signif_label <- function(p) sprintf("%s  p = %s",
  as.character(cut(p, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))), formatC(p, digits = 2, format = "g"))
box_by <- function(df, grp, levels, cols, title, ylab, cap) {
  df <- df[df[[grp]] %in% levels, ]; df[[grp]] <- factor(df[[grp]], levels = levels)
  n_by <- table(df[[grp]]); lv <- names(n_by)[n_by >= 3]
  stopifnot(nrow(df) > 0)
  ggplot(df, aes(.data[[grp]], score, fill = .data[[grp]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) + geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 1.8) +
    {if (length(lv) >= 2) geom_signif(comparisons = combn(lv, 2, simplify = FALSE), test = "wilcox.test",
                                      map_signif_level = signif_label, step_increase = 0.1, textsize = 3, tip_length = 0.01)} +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(sprintf("%s\n(n = %d)", names(n_by), as.integer(n_by)), names(n_by))) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.3))) + scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = ylab, caption = paste(strwrap(cap, 65), collapse = "\n")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
}

# Per-sample means; per-patient means of malignant cells in primaries (one point per patient).
# One point per patient and origin: 7 patients have several libraries of the same tumour.
per_patient <- d[, .(score = mean(CytoTRACE2_Score), n = .N), by = .(Patient_nr, origin)]
mal_patient <- d[Malignant == "Malignant" & origin == "primary",
                 .(score = mean(CytoTRACE2_Score), n = .N, secondary_mutation = secondary_mutation[1],
                   primary_location = primary_location[1], n_loc = uniqueN(primary_location)), by = Patient_nr]
stopifnot("a patient has two primary locations" = all(mal_patient$n_loc == 1))
mal_origin <- d[Malignant == "Malignant", .(score = mean(CytoTRACE2_Score), n = .N), by = .(Patient_nr, origin)]
mel_sample <- d[majority_celltype == "Melanocytes" & origin == "non-malignant",
                .(score = mean(CytoTRACE2_Score), n = .N, healthy_location = healthy_location[1]), by = Patient_nr][n >= 20]
cap_pat <- "One point per patient (mean over its malignant cells). Unadjusted two-sided Wilcoxon; groups with fewer than 3 patients are drawn but not tested."
```

CytoTRACE2 (developmental potential, 0 = differentiated, 1 = totipotent) was scored on all `r format(nrow(d), big.mark = ",")` cells of the October 2026 atlas, one library at a time. The stemness signature is the set of genes whose expression correlates with the CytoTRACE2 score.

# {.tabset}

## Score overview

```{r celltype, fig.height = 6}
ord <- d[, .(m = median(CytoTRACE2_Score)), by = majority_celltype][order(m), majority_celltype]
stopifnot("cell type without a colour" = all(ord %in% names(majority_celltype_col)))
ggplot(d, aes(factor(majority_celltype, levels = ord), CytoTRACE2_Score, fill = majority_celltype)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = majority_celltype_col, guide = "none") +
  coord_flip() + labs(title = "CytoTRACE2 score by cell type (all cells)", x = NULL, y = "CytoTRACE2 score") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 40))  # longest cell-type name was clipped
```

```{r origin_patient, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6}
box_by(per_patient[, .(origin, score)], "origin", levels(d$origin), origin_colors,
       "Mean CytoTRACE2 score per patient, all cells", "Mean CytoTRACE2 score",
       "One point per patient and origin (all cells); 8 patients have both a tumour and its adjacent normal, so the groups are not fully independent. Differences mix cell-type composition and cell state; the malignant-only tabs separate the two.")
```

## UMAP

Atlas UMAP (as shipped with the October object) coloured by CytoTRACE2 score and by cell type, as a visual check.

```{r umap, fig.width = 18, fig.height = 8.5}
um <- merge(fread(file.path(ct_dir, "atlas_umap.csv.gz")), d[, .(cell, CytoTRACE2_Score, majority_celltype)], by = "cell")
stopifnot("UMAP and score cells differ" = nrow(um) == nrow(d))
um <- um[sample(.N)]  # random draw order: no cell type painted over the others
p_sc <- ggplot(um, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = CytoTRACE2_Score)) +
  scattermore::geom_scattermore(pointsize = 1.2) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma", limits = c(0, 1), name = "CytoTRACE2\nscore") +
  labs(title = "CytoTRACE2 score") + theme_void(base_size = 13) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
lab <- um[, .(UMAP_1 = median(UMAP_1), UMAP_2 = median(UMAP_2)), by = majority_celltype]
p_ct <- ggplot(um, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = majority_celltype)) +
  scattermore::geom_scattermore(pointsize = 1.2) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = majority_celltype), colour = "black", size = 3.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = majority_celltype_col, guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Cell type") + theme_void(base_size = 13) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
p_sc | p_ct
```

```{r malignant, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 6}

             "Primary vs metastasis", "Mean CytoTRACE2 score, malignant cells",
             "One point per patient and origin (a patient with both contributes to each).")
p2 <- box_by(mal_patient[primary_location == "choroid"], "secondary_mutation", c("BAP1", "SF3B1", "EIF1AX"),
             second_mutations_col, "Secondary mutation, choroidal pUM", "Mean CytoTRACE2 score, malignant cells", cap_pat)
p3 <- box_by(mal_patient, "primary_location", c("choroid", "iris", "ciliary body"), primary_location_colors,

p1 | p2 | p3
```

```{r melanocytes, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6}
box_by(mel_sample, "healthy_location", c("choroid", "iris", "ciliary body"), primary_location_colors,
```

## Stemness signature {.tabset}

Pearson correlation between the CytoTRACE2 score and each gene's log-normalised expression (log1p of counts per 10,000), computed within each cell set. Genes expressed in at least 1% of the set's cells. Top = most positively correlated (stemness), Bottom = most negatively correlated (differentiation).

### Top genes

```{r top_genes, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 9}
bar <- function(s) {
  x <- rbind(sig[[s]][direction == "Top"][1:25], sig[[s]][direction == "Bottom"][1:25])
  ggplot(x, aes(correlation, reorder(gene, correlation), fill = direction)) + geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Top = "firebrick3", Bottom = "steelblue4")) +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s (n = %s cells)", sets[[s]], format(set_n[[s]], big.mark = ",")),
         x = "Pearson r with CytoTRACE2 score", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) + theme(legend.position = "none")
}
wrap_plots(lapply(names(sets), bar), nrow = 1) +
  plot_annotation(title = "25 most positively and 25 most negatively correlated genes per cell set")
```

### Malignant vs melanocytes

```{r concordance, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 8}
cmp <- merge(cors$malignant[, .(gene, r_malignant = correlation)],
             cors$healthy_melanocyte[, .(gene, r_melanocyte = correlation)], by = "gene")
top_m <- sig$malignant$gene; top_h <- sig$healthy_melanocyte$gene
cmp[, class := fcase(gene %in% top_m & gene %in% top_h, "top 50 in both",
                     gene %in% top_m, "top 50 malignant only",
                     gene %in% top_h, "top 50 melanocytes only", default = "other")]
cmp[, class := factor(class, levels = c("other", "top 50 malignant only", "top 50 melanocytes only", "top 50 in both"))]
setorder(cmp, class)
r_all <- cor(cmp$r_malignant, cmp$r_melanocyte)
p <- ggplot(cmp, aes(r_melanocyte, r_malignant, colour = class, text = gene)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(other = "grey80", `top 50 malignant only` = "firebrick3",
                                 `top 50 melanocytes only` = "steelblue4", `top 50 in both` = "darkorange")) +
  labs(title = sprintf("Per-gene correlation with CytoTRACE2: malignant cells vs non-malignant melanocytes (r = %.2f across %s genes)",
                       r_all, format(nrow(cmp), big.mark = ",")),
       x = "r in non-malignant melanocytes", y = "r in malignant cells", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text", width = 900, height = 720)
```

```{r overlap_counts, include = FALSE}
ov <- sapply(c("Top", "Bottom"), function(dir) length(intersect(sig$malignant[direction == dir, gene],
                                                                  sig$healthy_melanocyte[direction == dir, gene])))
```

Of the top `r n_sig` stemness genes, `r ov[["Top"]]` are shared between malignant cells and non-malignant melanocytes; of the top `r n_sig` differentiation genes, `r ov[["Bottom"]]` are shared. Hover a point for the gene name.

### Downloads

```{r downloads, results = "asis", echo = FALSE}
for (s in names(sets)) {
  cat(as.character(xfun::embed_file(file.path(ct_dir, sprintf("stemness_signature_%s_top%d.csv", s, n_sig)),
                                    text = sprintf("Stemness signature, %s (top/bottom %d)", sets[[s]], n_sig))), "\n\n")
  cat(as.character(xfun::embed_file(file.path(ct_dir, sprintf("gene_cor_%s.csv", s)),
                                    text = sprintf("All gene correlations, %s", sets[[s]]))), "\n\n")
}
```

## Methods and session info

- **CytoTRACE2** 1.1.0, `cytotrace2(species = "human", batch_size = 10000, seed = 14)` on RNA counts, run per library so the KNN smoothing never mixes libraries (`run_cytotrace2_2026b.R`). Scores from the January 2025 object were not reused: counts changed in all 63 libraries.
- **Cell sets**: malignant = iCNV `Malignant` label shipped in the October object; non-malignant melanocytes = `majority_celltype == "Melanocytes"` in non-malignant samples.
- **Stemness signature**: Pearson r of CytoTRACE2 score with log1p(CP10k) expression, genes detected in at least 1% of the set; top and bottom `r n_sig` genes. Cell-level correlations, so they describe co-variation across cells, not a patient-level effect.
- **Statistics**: per-patient or per-sample means, unadjusted two-sided Wilcoxon; groups below 3 not tested.

```{r session}
sessionInfo()
```
